The idea is to provide some standardized fields that are common regardless of the underlying record type (with the exception of `annotations`, which is the catch-all generic/opaque map you describe).

One approach is to keep them separate and rely on clients to populate. This makes things like transforming values easier e.g. if we want to convert PipelineRun/TaskRun error reasons to a common error type.

The other option is to have a reference to fields within the Record, (e.g. similar to [additionalPrinterColumns](https://github.com/tektoncd/pipeline/blob/1ecb48215f4dd07bdf2567b5e7c8f7e4939da13b/config/300-pipelinerun.yaml#L73-L85), but this adds complexity to Result retrieval (e.g. for every Result fetch you need to also fetch the Result summary Record).
